source_boundary.mode: Individual source-route audit of the existing 249-ID core SDK partition
source_boundary.signature_policy: Each id refers to the exact original inventory declaration, parameters, defaults and return_annotation. No adapter signature replaces that declaration. Original path/line/symbol are repeated per row; the immutable signature projection is fingerprinted below.
source_boundary.signature_projection_format: Owned original rows sorted by id; retain present id,kind,parameters,return_annotation,origin keys; UTF-8 JSON sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=false plus LF
source_boundary.anchor_revision_rule: Code/source/test paths and their line numbers resolve at code_revision; docs/parity/sdk-surface.json resolves at inventory_revision. README.md is the supplied read-only schema pinned by its bytes; build/artifacts paths are completed-run evidence. All 61 applicable Git blobs matched the captured hashes. Later parallel worktree archive/proxy edits do not redefine this requested-revision map.

forward_transport.role: C overwrites pluginId and ownerToken from immutable interpreter state
real C JSON transport and handle marshalling
typed owner/reflection validation and concrete provider dispatch

reverse_transport.role: resolve C handle and invoke the requested Python method

composition.role: installs UI, TL, NativeServices and settings providers; URL and notification sites are explicitly supplied at lines 178-181

source_boundary.route_convention: Rows name actual bodies and terminal consumers. Calls reaching Platform.call or the C-backed proxy use forward_transport; retained callbacks use reverse_transport. Pure helpers and metadata end at their actual Python body/declaration.
source_boundary.hash_scope: 65 inputs: 60 code/test/original-source Git blobs at code_revision, the inventory Git blob at inventory_revision, the supplied README schema bytes and three locally retained completed-Mac reports. Output documents are excluded; this is not a transitive compiler-input closure.
source_boundary.historical_evidence_scope: Completed Mac 43738810843/136 has three green SDK children and C219. Its Foundation DTO/Host/C evidence does not establish UIKit, production RPC, delivery or individual execution of these 249 symbols. No in-progress run was queried.
source_boundary.new_counterexamples: Five bounded isolated-AST body counterexamples only; no plugin loading, C/Host execution, UIKit or network in this audit. These are not a full runtime pass.

findings.title: AccountClient.edit_message turns omission into explicit spoiler=false

anchors.role: explicit spoiler triggers media-reference edit and can reject text-only messages

findings.counterexample: For explicit native target {peer:{type:user,id:7},id:9,namespace:0}, module edit_message(target,text='replacement',account=2) omits spoiler; AccountClient(2).edit_message(target,text='replacement') emits spoiler:false. Native media=nil plus spoiler!=nil takes the media requirement branch; a text-only cached message yields EDIT_SPOILER_REQUIRES_MEDIA.

reproduction.boundary: Native-media admission replaced by a data recorder; native rejection is established from the actual Swift branch, not executed here.

findings.fix_needed: Adapt AccountClient edit forwarding so an omitted spoiler remains omitted while an explicitly supplied False remains distinguishable; retain explicit peer/id/namespace and native validation.

findings.title: Outgoing-message hook registration discards its priority
findings.counterexample: Executing the retained SDK registration body with priority 100 and -100 through the installed Platform.addSendMessageHook body produces identical instance state: {_exteraless_send_message_registered:true}. Host cannot distinguish the requested priorities; whichever subscriber is first may CANCEL/MODIFY_FINAL before the intended higher-priority hook.

reproduction.kind: isolated AST registration bodies plus native source comparison
reproduction.boundary: No real plugins or native event queue executed.

findings.fix_needed: Retain the send-hook priority and expose an owner-safe read/query used to order the native send chain, preserving permissions, cancellation and captured-owner guards.

findings.title: find_class returns a positive proxy for an absent allowed native class

anchors.role: unregistered name gets JavaClass without existence query
actual native existence authority has a closed class set

findings.counterexample: With class permission allowed, find_class('org.telegram.messenger.CoreApiMissingClass') returns <JavaClass ...> even when backend.class_exists would return false. The exact helper body plus actual virtualjava resolver makes zero class_exists queries.

reproduction.kind: isolated AST helper with actual virtualjava resolver
reproduction.boundary: Permission/name adapters were fixed to the allowed identity case; backend was a false-existence recorder, not C or Host.

findings.fix_needed: Keep registered Python ports/aliases, but consult the actual native class_exists authority before treating an unregistered class as present; preserve fail-soft None and existing permission gates.

findings.title: Request callbacks lost the original safe_call exception containment

anchors.role: original bare callback also uses safe_call

findings.counterexample: A callback raising ValueError('source-counter-only') escapes the installed RequestCallback.run body. Both original callback routes execute safe_call, which logs and returns None for that Exception instead.

reproduction.boundary: Only hook_scope was replaced by a data-only context manager; no request, native callback or plugin lifecycle ran.

findings.fix_needed: Restore the original user-callback error guard at bare completion and RequestCallback.run boundaries while retaining strict schema/native errors, account scope and native-owned terminal/FIFO release bookkeeping.

findings.title: OwnerQueue.cancelRunnable cancels the same callback across other queue names

anchors.role: original removes callbacks only from this queue's Handler
selects callback identity across the global task table
native correctly cancels each requested owner-scoped id

findings.counterexample: The same callback is pending as stage-task on STAGE_QUEUE and global-task on GLOBAL_QUEUE. Calling the STAGE_QUEUE OwnerQueue.cancelRunnable(callback) selects and sends cancelOwnerTask for both ids; original DispatchQueue.cancelRunnable only calls its own handler.removeCallbacks.

reproduction.boundary: Tasks/leases and positive native Bool replies were data recorders; no timer, plugin, C or native scheduler ran.

findings.fix_needed: Carry the originating queue identity into callback-based cancellation selection so another queue's tasks are retained; preserve positive native Bool winner and native-owned FIFO release rules.
